english.title: Install or modify machinery/apparatus whereby additional water can be abstracted when abstraction prohibited
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the abstraction of water contained in an underground strata having been prohibited except than in pursuance of a licence under Chapter II of Part II of the Water Resources Act 1991,

(A)_[began]_
(B)_[caused another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(C)_[permitted another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

to

(D)_[install]_
(E)_[modify]_

(F)_[machinery]_
(G)_[apparatus]_

by which additional quantities of water may be abstracted from those strata by means of a

(H)_[well]_
(I)_[borehole]_
(J)_[work, namely **(..SPECIFY WORK..),]_

when the conditions specified in section 24(3) of that Act had not been satisfied in that **(..SPECIFY CONDITION OR CONDITIONS AND HOW IT OR THEY HAD NOT BEEN SATISFIED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24(2)(c), (4)(a) and (5) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
the abstraction of water contained in underground strata having been prohibited other than in pursuance of a licence
under Chapter II of Part II of the Water Resources Act 1991,
began to instal or modify machinery or apparatus
by which additional quantities of water may be abstracted from those strata
by means of a well, borehole or other work
when the conditions specified in section 24(3) of that Act had not been satisfied
